title: Requirement declared from a direct URL
description: requirements.txt declares a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index. Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index.
remediation: Regenerate the artifact with integrity data enabled and commit the recorded digest or checksum. Specifically: fix a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index.
limitation: It matches a PEP 508 `@` URL that is fetched outside the index in the parsed requirements.txt; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
